title: Contact Body Position Low And Strong (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl steel guitar mandolin
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, contact rewards low body position
Low man wins, every single time
Hips below hips, shoulders below shoulders

[Verse 1]
Approaching contact, drop the centre of gravity
Knees bent, hips low, back flat with cavity
Shoulder leads into the contact zone
Ball in two hands, tucked close to the bone

[Pre-Chorus]
Drive the legs through the contact line
Four quick steps after impact, stay fine
Fight to stay on the feet, son, never go down
Leg drive past the gain line, win the crown

[Chorus]
Contact body position low and strong, son
Low man wins, the work begun
Hips below hips, shoulder lead in
Leg drive through, dont give in

[Verse 2]
If you stand tall in contact, you go backward
If you go low, you go forward
The physics never lies, son
Low body position, the contact won

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, watch the front rowers
They live in low body position, the powers
Squat low all day, drive low all day
Thats how forwards win the way

[Chorus]
Contact body position low and strong, son
Low man wins, the work begun
Hips below hips, shoulder lead in
Leg drive through, dont give in

[Outro]
Low hips, low shoulder
Leg drive past, never older
Four foot pumps, stay on feet
Thats my boy, contact sweet
